text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins.
It's sweltering hot again this year, but the Umamusume
run under the blazing sun without a second thought—
—Except for ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Our training camp
starts here... doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Sorry... It's because of me...
Yeah. Sorry... for dragging you into my personal business.

text_block_list.text:
There's no sign of recovery from my recent slump...
Unable to bear the piercing, harsh sunlight...
I ended up starting after dark.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I'm grateful. Lately...
sunlight has been particularly bothersome to me as well.

Of course, the main focus of the training camp is daytime.
After this, the plan is to gradually increase daytime activity, but first—
choice_data_list: Let's review various movements during the night.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well then, tonight as well...
I will be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"So that's how it is.
...How pitiful."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to suffocate.
Those two are just...â

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe
will say……"welcome back."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
You haven't gone to sleep yet?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
I was waiting for Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe's fate did not change.
Because that was the only choice available."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's fate has changed.
Because that was the choice you made.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “However, what lies ahead…… isn't 'HPED'.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ALRM"...
Is the rest... okay to be "that"?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I don't quite understand what you're saying.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
How is your injury doing?
Please don't push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I will pray for you...
Good night, Universe-san."
